Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC:** Lip swelling after prawn soup

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient ate prawn soup at approximately 19:00 after work.
Approximately 30 minutes after eating prawn soup, the left corner of the lip felt weird followed by upper lip swelling that was getting bigger and worse.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Onset ~30 min later: lip felt “weird” at L corner → upper lip swelling, “getting bigger/worse”

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports throat symptoms described as feeling she cannot breathe well.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Throat sx: feels can’t breathe well

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports chest generally feels a little difficult and is unsure if this represents tightness.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Chest: “generally feels a little difficult,” unsure if tightness

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Approximately one year ago, after late-night Chinese food while intoxicated, patient woke the next morning quite swollen up with difficult breathing.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: • ~1 yr ago after late-night Chinese food while intoxicated: woke next morning “quite swollen up” + difficult breathing

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient is unsure of the trigger of the prior reaction, possibly curry.
During the call, patient reports worsening lip swelling, shortness of breath, and dizziness.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: During call: pt reports worsening lip swelling + SOB + dizziness

Past_Medical_History.content: History of peanut allergy since childhood.
Possible severe peanut allergy reaction at approximately age 6 requiring hospital visit per patient recollection.
Past_Medical_History.source_text: possible severe reaction age ~6 w/ hospital visit per pt recollection

Medications.content: Patient sometimes takes antihistamines for peanut allergy; medication name unknown.
Medications.source_text: Sometimes takes antihistamines for peanut allergy (unknown name)

Assessment.content: Suspected anaphylaxis due to lip swelling after prawn exposure with shortness of breath, throat symptoms, possible chest tightness, dizziness, history of peanut allergy, and prior similar reaction.
Assessment.source_text: Suspected anaphylaxis (lip swelling after prawn exposure with SOB/throat sx, possible chest tightness, dizziness; hx peanut allergy, prior similar reaction).

Plan_of_Care.content: Call 999 for an ambulance immediately and advise that this is a suspected anaphylactic reaction.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Call 999 for ambulance now; advise “suspected anaphylactic reaction”

Plan_of_Care.content: Ensure someone stays with the patient until emergency medical services arrive; initially patient was alone and mother arrived during the call.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Ensure someone stays with pt until EMS arrives (initially alone; mum arrived during call)

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient to take available antihistamine while awaiting ambulance if found at home.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Take available antihistamine while awaiting ambulance (if found at home)

Plan_of_Care.content: After hospital care, follow up to arrange adrenaline auto-injectors and ongoing allergy management.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: After hospital: follow up to arrange adrenaline auto-injector(s) and ongoing allergy management

Follow_up_Information.content: After hospital treatment, patient should follow up to arrange adrenaline auto-injectors and ongoing allergy management.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: After hospital: follow up to arrange adrenaline auto-injector(s) and ongoing allergy management

Physical_Findings.content: No vital signs or physical examination findings documented.

Review_of_Systems.content: Positive for throat symptoms described as feeling she cannot breathe well.
Review_of_Systems.source_text: Throat sx: feels can’t breathe well

Review_of_Systems.content: Positive for chest discomfort described as generally feeling a little difficult.
Review_of_Systems.source_text: Chest: “generally feels a little difficult,” unsure if tightness

Review_of_Systems.content: Positive for shortness of breath during the call.
